claims.text: The retry queue discards a payment message whenever the downstream broker rejects the delivery attempt.
Payment messages disappear from the retry queue after the downstream broker refuses a delivery attempt.
The retry queue drops the payment message silently once the downstream broker returns a rejection.
A rejected delivery attempt leaves the payment message deleted from the retry queue without any record.
The retry queue preserves every payment message even when the downstream broker rejects a delivery attempt.
No payment message leaves the retry queue unacknowledged after the downstream broker refuses a delivery attempt.
Payment messages remain inside the retry queue when the downstream broker returns a rejection.
A rejected delivery attempt causes the retry queue to hold the payment message for another send.
The retry queue loses a payment message only when the downstream broker rejects the same delivery attempt repeatedly.
Some payment messages leave the retry queue unrecorded after the downstream broker refuses a delivery attempt.
The retry queue drops a payment message under sustained rejection from the downstream broker.
A rejected delivery attempt removes the payment message from the retry queue about half of the sends.
The retry queue writes each rejected payment message to a holding store before the downstream broker answers again.
Payment messages rejected by the downstream broker are counted by the retry queue and then discarded.
The retry queue reports a rejection from the downstream broker but keeps no copy of the payment message.
A rejected delivery attempt moves the payment message out of the retry queue into an error path.
The retry queue acknowledges a payment message to the sender even after the downstream broker rejects it.
Payment messages rejected by the downstream broker stay in the retry queue until an operator clears them.
The retry queue loses the payment message and the rejection from the downstream broker at the same instant.
A rejected delivery attempt from the downstream broker never removes the payment message from the retry queue.

question: Assess whether the payment retry queue loses messages when the downstream broker rejects a delivery attempt, and how the loss should be detected.
